risks.title: Prompt Injection
risks.summary: Malicious input overrides intended instructions, incl. zero-click indirect injection (e.g. EchoLeak CVE-2025-32711).

risks.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
risks.summary: Cross-tenant leakage via retrieval, scores/timing, or auth flaws compounding RAG.

risks.title: Excessive Agency
risks.summary: Over-permissioned tools/memory allow unintended actions. Promoted from 6th to 3rd.

risks.title: Supply Chain
risks.summary: Poisoned data, models, components, and plugins in the LLM lifecycle.

risks.title: Data and Model Poisoning
risks.summary: Training/fine-tune/RAG data tampering (was Training Data Poisoning).

risks.title: Unbounded Consumption
risks.summary: Resource exhaustion / Model DoS broadened beyond rate limits.

risks.title: Misinformation
risks.summary: Overreliance reframed: plausible but false outputs acted on without verification.

risks.title: Hidden Context Exposure
risks.summary: System prompt leakage renamed: hidden instructions/context revealed.

risks.title: Weak Vectors and Embeddings
risks.summary: New: embedding inversion, similarity leakage, weak access control on retrieval.

risks.title: Improper Output Handling
risks.summary: Unsanitized model output passed to sinks (was 5th, now 10th).
